finding: Apple's current EVGO App Store listing independently validates both the native operator/app relationship and the cp.evgo.ma branded backend association: the listed provider is Nareva Services, the developer website is evgo.ma, and the privacy-policy link points to cp.evgo.ma.

cpo_operator.note: Do not use EVGO visibility in a roaming app to overwrite another physical CPO attribution.

site_brand.rule: Keep the physical site/host brand separate from EVGO/Nareva.

tariff_channel.rule: Treat tariffs returned by the native cp.evgo.ma/EVGO client as EVGO direct only when the station payload itself is validated; do not infer tariffs from the App Store listing.

status_source.reason: The App Store privacy-policy link independently binds the official EVGO client to cp.evgo.ma, corroborating the already validated anonymous AMPECO routes and fresh native status overlays.

roaming_priority.rule: For an EVGO/Nareva station also visible in EVOne, prefer a fresh native cp.evgo.ma status over the EVOne roaming status when both are available.
